sections.label: Exchanges demutualisation and merger Act
sections.summary: In 1999 the EDMA was passed to facilitate transferring ownership of SES, SIMEX and SCCS to Singapore Exchange Ltd.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: In 1999, the Exchanges (Demutualisation and Merger) Act (EDMA) was passed to facilitate the transfer of ownership of the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES), the Singapore International Monetary Exchange (SIMEX) and the Securities Clearing and Computer Services (SCCS), to an integrated exchange, Singapore Exchange Ltd (SGX).

sections.label: Amending EDMA for SEL shares
sections.summary: Amending the EDMA lets SEL elect to receive new SGX shares from corporate actions, with the Minister-in-charge's approval.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Amending the EDMA will give SEL flexibility to elect to receive new SGX shares arising from SGX's corporate actions, where doing so is in line with FSDF’s interests.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Bill will allow SEL, with the Minister-in-charge's approval, to participate in SGX's corporate actions under which SEL may opt to receive additional SGX shares.

sections.label: Conditions on new SGX shares
sections.summary: SEL holds new SGX shares for the FSDF, cannot transact or vote them, and their dividends and sale proceeds accrue to the FSDF.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: In particular, consistent with the Original SGX shares: one, SEL will hold the new SGX shares for the benefit of the FSDF; two, SEL will not be allowed to transact with the new SGX shares without the prior approval of or direction from the Minister-in-charge of MAS; three, SEL will not be able to exercise the voting rights attached to the new SGX shares; and four, the dividends paid in respect of the new SGX shares and any proceeds in respect of any sale of the new SGX shares, less expenses incurred in the sale of the new SGX shares, will accrue to the FSDF.

sections.label: SGX ownership structure
sections.summary: SGX's ownership is highly diversified with international shareholders, and SEL Holdings Pte Ltd is the largest single shareholder at around 23%.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Turning to the structure of SGX, the listed company itself, to which this Bill and its amendments relate, I note that the company's ownership structure is highly diversified, with many international shareholders from large asset managers like BlackRock and Schroders to pension funds like the Japanese government pension fund.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The largest single shareholder remains SEL Holdings Pte Ltd with around 23% of shares, although I note as well that there is a restriction on the exercise of its voting rights attached to its shares.

sections.label: Subscription offers to shareholders
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the amendments allow subscription offers to be made to existing SGX shareholders.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Do the amendments allow subscription offers to be made to existing SGX shareholders?

sections.label: FSDF as share beneficiary
sections.summary: The beneficiary of these shares, old and new, is the Financial Sector Development Fund (FSDF).

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The beneficiary of these shares, old and new, is the Financial Sector Development Fund (FSDF).

sections.label: SEL Holdings SGX share amendments
sections.summary: The amendments let SEL Holdings hold SGX shares allotted and issued for demutualisation and merger for later placements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: The amendments would allow SEL Holdings Pte Ltd (SEL) as the special purpose company under the EDMA to strengthen itself by allowing it to hold Singapore Exchange Ltd (SGX) shares allotted and issued in connection with the demutualisation and merger for subsequent placements.

sections.label: FSDF COVID-19 support package
sections.summary: During the COVID-19 pandemic, FSDF launched a $125 million support package for financial services sector capabilities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Even during the COVID-19 pandemic, FSDF launched a $125 million support package to sustain and strengthen capabilities in the financial services sector.

sections.label: SGX growth and non-voting shares
sections.summary: SGX grew as a leading Asian market, and its shares held by SEL are non-voting to avoid MAS conflicts of interest.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Over the years, SGX has grown in stature and is recognised as one of the leading markets in Asia.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: It has a market capitalisation of around US$678 billion in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: There are also many other spin-offs from the running of a successful stock exchange as it creates countless jobs for the many listed companies, apart from the accountants, compliance staff as well as auditors, all of whom would be involved in the regulatory reporting process.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: I note that SGX shares held by SEL are non-voting to enable MAS to play a dual role as SGX's regulator and FSDF's administrator, without conflicts of interests.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: After all, it eventually feeds as part of a stable source of fund into FSDF.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: This Bill is a timely response to the recent announcement by Singapore Exchange Ltd (SGX) to offer a scrip dividend scheme (SDS) to shareholders.

sections.label: FSDF income and expenditure
sections.summary: FSDF income from SGX shares was about $78 million in FY2020, while expenditure rose to $247 million.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: The point is FSDF’s income obtained from SGX shares came up to about $78 million in FY2020.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: On the other hand, it is worth noting that the expenditure for FSDF has increased to $247 million in the same financial year.

sections.label: SEL stake in SGX
sections.summary: SEL's current stake in SGX is about 23%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: SEL's current stake in SGX is about 23%.

sections.label: MAS regulator independence
sections.summary: MAS' independence as a regulator should not be affected by potential conflict of interest.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: First, on potential conflict of interest, MAS' independence as a regulator should not be affected.

sections.label: SEL SGX shares voting rights
sections.summary: SEL derives income from holding SGX shares, benefiting the FSDF, but is not accorded voting rights for those shares.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Further, even as SEL derives income from holding of SGX shares and this benefits the FSDF, SEL is not accorded voting rights for its SGX shares.

sections.label: FSDF expenditure in FY2020/2021
sections.summary: In FY2020/2021, FSDF's annual expenditure increased to $247 million as new support schemes were launched amid COVID-19 disruptions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In FY2020/2021, FSDF's annual expenditure increased to $247 million as new support schemes were launched to sustain and strengthen capabilities in our financial services and fintech sectors, amidst all of the COVID-19 disruptions.

sections.label: Training participation in 2021
sections.summary: Training participation in the first 10 months of 2021 was triple that of the whole of 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In fact, the level of training participation in the first 10 months of 2021 was already triple that, compared to the whole of 2019.

sections.label: SEL scrip dividend approval and FSDF position
sections.summary: SEL's participation in SGX's scrip dividend scheme and proportion elected require approval by the Minister-in-charge of MAS, and FSDF's current financial position is strong.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: First, the decision for SEL to participate in SGX's scrip dividend scheme and the proportion of scrip dividend that SEL will elect for, as I mentioned earlier, will have to be approved by the Minister-in-charge of MAS, based on FSDF's expected financial needs over the medium term.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Second, FSDF's current financial position is in fact strong.

sections.label: FSDF support and scrip dividends
sections.summary: FSDF has supported the financial sector, especially during COVID-19, and is geared for future demands, and scrip dividends should not adversely affect its ability to support the sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: This has enabled FSDF to provide significant support to the financial sector, especially during the recent COVID-19 crisis period and FSDF is also geared up to meet potential future demands as the industry responds to new trends in digitalisation and sustainability.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: But should SEL choose to elect for scrip dividends, this should not adversely affect FSDF's ability to support the financial sector.

sections.label: MAS approval for SGX strategic investors
sections.summary: MAS will allow suitable, strategic investors who can promote SGX's growth to acquire stakes of 5% or more, subject to MAS approval.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: MAS will allow suitable, strategic investors who can promote SGX's growth and development to acquire substantial stakes of 5% or more in SGX and such strategic investors must first seek MAS' approval.

sections.label: Citation year change
sections.summary: The citation year "2021" will be changed to "2022", as indicated in the Order Paper Supplement.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: The citation year "2021" will be changed to "2022", as indicated in the Order Paper Supplement.
